note: An instant-world UI is a trace product, not an asset. Promotion is the only path into the contribution chain, so the status/promoted_skill_id pair must stay consistent.

cases.why: an artifact without an id cannot be content-addressed or linked from the trace
artifact kinds are closed; an unknown kind has no renderer contract
without a content hash the artifact cannot be verified or deduplicated
a zero-byte artifact is not a rendered interface
only two life-cycle states exist: ephemeral or promoted
the promoted skill reference must be a string id or explicit null

validMutations.why: a promoted artifact carrying a skill id and timestamp is the legitimate second state

semanticCases.why: promotion without a target skill would put an orphan into the contribution chain
an ephemeral artifact must not claim a skill id; that is the 'not an asset yet' guarantee
promotion is an event; without promoted_at the contribution chain cannot order it
